decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet sits close to the firm's textile and material know-how and still has its own page in 2024, so management can read its results well and sees no reason to withdraw it.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's craftsmanship and fine-materials expertise and remains featured on its own page, making it a stable premium addition.

The corner bench only builds on the established offer and dropped from its own page to a mere mention in 2024, which signals weaker emphasis, but it is still promoted as a new interpretation and fits the firm's furniture know-how, so it is kept for now.
The low-pile carpet matches the firm's existing knowledge base and keeps its own page, although the earlier withdrawal of the similar Product C shows the carpet range is being pruned.
The swivel shell chair line has several models, sits close to the core seating competence and is consistently featured, so it uses absorbed design knowledge well and is likely to be kept.
